description: This Java class implements an in-memory bootstrap configuration store for LwM2M protocol, managing bootstrap configs with thread safety, and handling PSK identity checks.

classes.name: LwM2MInMemoryBootstrapConfigStore
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory store for LwM2M bootstrap configurations, extending InMemoryBootstrapConfigStore, with PSK identity management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the BootstrapConfig for a given endpoint.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all bootstrap configurations in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new bootstrap configuration for a specified endpoint, with thread safety.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the bootstrap configuration for a specified endpoint.

methods.name: addToStore
methods.description: Validates and adds a bootstrap configuration to the store, ensuring PSK identity uniqueness.
